edit_denied: Only the GM or the assigned player can edit this clock.
owner_gm_only: Only the GM decides who can edit a clock.
closed_reopen_first: The clock is closed — reopen it first.
abandoned_gm: Only the GM can bring back an abandoned clock.
gm_only: Only the GM can hide a clock from the table.
closed_frozen: The clock is closed: only visibility and rights can change.
